title.zh: CoQ 国际象棋·围棋棋钟

description.en: The whole half-screen is the button. Fischer increment, Bronstein delay, byoyomi and sudden death — built for a phone lying flat between two players, and it keeps running offline.
description.zh: 整块半屏就是按钮：Fischer 加秒、Bronstein 延时、读秒与包干四种模式。手机平放在两位棋手之间就能开一局，断网也照常走。

imageAlt.en: The clock mid-game in facing mode
imageAlt.zh: 对局中的棋钟（对坐模式）

description.en: Load any SGF and walk its variations on a 13×13 board. A blue line for the connection, a dimmed corner for what you are not discussing, a red arrow on the move — the markup I use when teaching beginners. The browser build runs offline; the desktop app adds GTP engines and native dialogs.
description.zh: 读入任意 SGF，在 13×13 棋盘上逐手浏览变化。蓝线标出连络、淡化角落表示「先不看这里」、红箭头指向那一手——教初学者时我就这样摆。浏览器版可离线使用，桌面版另有 GTP 引擎与原生文件对话框。

imageAlt.en: A real 13×13 game in MultiGo Neo: a dimmed corner, a blue line showing White's connection and a red arrow on the move
imageAlt.zh: MultiGo Neo 里的一局 13 路实战：角落被淡化，蓝线标出白棋的连络，红箭头指向刚才那一手
